about: Real Units 0.2 for Digitakt OS 1.54: the author's released .elemod file, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: Real Units: Hz, ms and note lengths
mods.summary: Ten Digitakt MKI mods: new LFO waves with pictures, a looping random LFO, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real units, mute snapshots, track solo, velocity humanise and Euclidean accents.
mods.description: Knob values in real units. The filter's FREQ in hertz (as Filter Hz, which this replaces), the filter envelope's ATK, DEC, REL and DEL and the amp envelope's ATK, HOLD and DEC in milliseconds or seconds (INF at 127 where the stock never ends), and the LFO SPD and MULT pop-ups add the LFO's cycle length: bars, a note value or steps with the tempo, Hz free-running. Every number comes from the tables the sound engine itself uses.
mods.author: Cere, made with Claude
mods.on_unit: All ten tested together on a real Digitakt MKI (OS 1.54) with core and seq-events: LFO waves and pictures, Deja Vu loops and destinations, Kit A/B, Ctrl All, real-unit displays, mute snapshots, track solo, humanise, Euclid accents and the MOD SETTINGS row. OS 1.53 not supported.
